recovery_action: Clean Context Restart with Explicit Constraints (Option 2)
restart_prompt_invariants: Channel Multiplexing: Every subscription and event emission is strictly scoped to `team:${teamId}`.
Bounded Reconnection Buffer: Circular buffer per team (max 50 events) allowing reconnecting clients to replay events missed since last known ISO timestamp.
Decoupled Connection Lifecycle: `subscribe()` returns an explicit teardown function `() => unsubscribe(teamId, callback)` that cleans up EventEmitter listeners and deletes empty map entries.
Data Integrity: Frozen `ACTIVITY_TYPES` enum and strict parameter validation rejecting unverified payloads.
verification_status: All 4 critical scenarios verified passing: connection, event delivery, disconnection, and timestamped replay. 26/26 automated tests passing in tests/*.test.js.
